image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large marine mammal surfacing in water. The visible portion shows the dark, mottled grey-black skin of the whale's back and head area breaking through white, foamy waves. Distinctive light-colored patches (likely barnacles or cyamids) are visible on the skin surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin clearly exhibits the characteristic mottled grey/black coloration with distinct lighter, rough-textured patches consistent with barnacle/cyamid infestation typical of grey whales.
